name: python-observability
description: Python structured logging, metrics, tracing, production debugging; explain what/where/why without deploying code.
Production JSON logs; human-readable locally. Track latency, traffic, errors, saturation at service boundaries. Generate unique ingress ID; propagate through logs, spans, outbound requests. Keep metric label values bounded. Unbounded labels (like user IDs) explode storage costs. Avoid labels with unbounded values to prevent metric explosion. Never log expected behavior at `ERROR`. A user entering a wrong password is `INFO`, not `ERROR`.
Logging: Configure `structlog` with `merge_contextvars`, `add_log_level`, `TimeStamper(fmt="iso")`, `StackInf
